text: This report recommends that the name "Lampard Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of Barton Avenue, extending between Pendrith Lane and Willowvale Lane. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Lampard Lane" for an existing public lane located north of Barton Avenue, extending between Pendrith Lane and Willowvale Lane.
